name: Build and Publish Release EXE
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'    # triggers on tag pushes like v1.0.0
jobs:
  build-and-release:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Build EXE with PyInstaller
        run: |
          pyinstaller --onefile --noconsole --name "WinRepairTool" --uac-admin --add-data "scripts;scripts" src\gui.py

      - name: Compute SHA256
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $exe = "dist\WinRepairTool.exe"
          $sha = Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $exe | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Hash
          $shaLine = "$sha  WinRepairTool.exe"
          $shaFile = "WinRepairTool-${{ github.ref_name }}.sha256"
          Set-Content -Path $shaFile -Value $shaLine -Encoding ASCII
          Write-Output "SHA256: $sha"

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          body: |
            Automated build for tag ${{ github.ref_name }}.
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload EXE to Release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: dist/WinRepairTool.exe
          asset_name: WinRepairTool.exe
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload SHA256 to Release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: WinRepairTool-${{ github.ref_name }}.sha256
          asset_name: WinRepairTool-${{ github.ref_name }}.sha256
          asset_content_type: text/plain
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
